name: docker-fundamentals
description: Build, run and debug Docker images and containers: Dockerfiles, layers, volumes, networks, logs. Use for Dockerfile and container issues. Detect docker first.

name: docker-compose
description: Define and run multi-container apps with Docker Compose: services, networks, volumes, env. Use for compose.yaml/docker-compose.yml.

name: docker-image-optimization
description: Shrink and harden container images: multi-stage builds, layer caching, distroless, scanning. Use when images are large or insecure.
pitfalls: Shipping compilers/build tools in the runtime image

name: podman
description: Use Podman as a daemonless, rootless Docker alternative: pods, systemd integration. Use when podman is the container runtime. Detect podman first.

name: kubernetes-core
description: Work with Kubernetes: pods, deployments, services, configmaps, secrets, probes, resources. Use for k8s manifests and cluster ops. Detect kubectl first.

name: kubernetes-helm
description: Package and deploy Kubernetes apps with Helm charts: templates, values, releases. Use for Chart.yaml/helm projects. Detect helm first.
pitfalls: No resource limits in chart defaults

name: kubernetes-kustomize
description: Manage Kubernetes config with Kustomize overlays: bases, patches, per-env config. Use for kustomization.yaml.
checklist: Base vs overlays separated per environment

name: kubernetes-troubleshooting
description: Diagnose Kubernetes failures: CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, pending pods, OOMKilled, networking. Use when pods/services misbehave.
pitfalls: Ignoring events (the real cause is often there)

name: gitops-argocd
description: Implement GitOps with Argo CD/Flux: declarative deploys, sync, drift detection. Use for GitOps workflows.
checklist: Git is the source of truth
pitfalls: Plaintext secrets in the Git repo

name: ci-cd-github-actions
description: Build CI/CD with GitHub Actions: workflows, jobs, matrix, caching, secrets, reusable workflows. Use for .github/workflows.
checklist: Caching for deps; matrix for coverage

name: ci-cd-gitlab
description: Build CI/CD with GitLab CI: stages, jobs, rules, artifacts, caches, environments. Use for .gitlab-ci.yml.
checklist: Stages and needs model the DAG
pitfalls: Leaking protected variables to unprotected branches

name: ci-cd-jenkins
description: Build pipelines with Jenkins declarative/scripted pipelines. Use for Jenkinsfile.
checklist: Credentials from the store, not literals

name: ci-cd-pipeline-design
description: Design fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines regardless of provider: caching, parallelism, gates, artifacts, promotion. Use when designing/improving pipelines.
pitfalls: Building artifacts twice instead of promoting

name: iac-terraform
description: Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform/OpenTofu: providers, state, modules, plan/apply. Use for .tf files. Detect terraform/tofu first.

name: iac-pulumi
description: Manage infrastructure as code with Pulumi in a real programming language. Use for Pulumi projects. Detect pulumi first.
pitfalls: Imperative side effects outside the resource graph

name: iac-ansible
description: Automate configuration with Ansible: playbooks, roles, inventories, idempotency. Use for playbook.yml/roles. Detect ansible first.
pitfalls: Using command where a module exists

name: iac-cloudformation
description: Provision AWS with CloudFormation/CDK/SAM templates: stacks, changesets, drift. Use for AWS templates. Detect aws cli first.

name: iac-packer-vagrant
description: Build machine images with Packer and dev VMs with Vagrant. Use for .pkr.hcl and Vagrantfile. Detect the tools first.

name: observability-prometheus
description: Instrument and query metrics with Prometheus/PromQL: exporters, scraping, recording/alerting rules. Use for metrics/monitoring.

name: observability-grafana
description: Build Grafana dashboards and alerts over metrics/logs/traces. Use when visualizing observability data.

name: observability-opentelemetry
description: Add distributed tracing and metrics with OpenTelemetry: spans, context propagation, exporters. Use when tracing across services.
pitfalls: Broken trace context across async boundaries

name: observability-logging
description: Centralize and query logs (ELK/Loki): structured logging, correlation, retention. Use for log aggregation/analysis.
checklist: Structured JSON logs with correlation ids

name: log-analysis
description: Analyze logs to find root cause: parsing, grep/jq/awk, timelines, correlation across services. Use when investigating incidents from logs.
pitfalls: Grepping only for ERROR and missing the real cause upstream

name: deployment-strategies
description: Deploy safely: blue-green, canary, rolling, feature flags, and fast rollback. Use when planning a release/rollout.

name: feature-flags
description: Use feature flags for progressive delivery, kill switches and experiments. Use when decoupling deploy from release.
pitfalls: Stale flags accumulating as tech debt
No default when the flag service is down

name: nginx-config
description: Configure and debug NGINX: reverse proxy, TLS, caching, rate limiting, load balancing. Use for nginx.conf. Detect nginx first.

name: caddy-traefik
description: Configure Caddy or Traefik as auto-TLS reverse proxies/ingress. Use for Caddyfile/Traefik config.
pitfalls: Rate limits on the wrong layer

name: load-balancing
description: Design load balancing and traffic management: L4/L7, algorithms, health checks, sticky sessions. Use when distributing traffic.

name: linux-administration
description: Administer Linux servers: systemd, users/permissions, packages, cron, disk/process management. Use for server ops on Linux.

name: windows-admin
description: Administer Windows systems with PowerShell: services, scheduled tasks, registry, WMI/CIM, event logs. Use for Windows server/desktop ops.
pitfalls: Assuming pwsh 7 features in Windows PowerShell 5.1

name: system-monitoring
description: Monitor host resources: CPU, memory, disk, IO, network, processes; find resource hogs. Use for performance/capacity triage.
pitfalls: Confusing load average with CPU usage

name: sre-slo
description: Define SLIs/SLOs/error budgets and design for reliability. Use when setting reliability targets and alerting.
checklist: Alerts fire on SLO burn, not raw metrics
pitfalls: Alerting on causes instead of symptoms

name: incident-response
description: Run incident response: detect, triage, mitigate, communicate, and write blameless postmortems. Use during/after outages.
pitfalls: Debugging in prod before mitigating impact

name: secrets-management-ops
description: Manage secrets across environments with Vault/SOPS/cloud secret managers: rotation, least access, no plaintext. Use for secret handling in infra.
checklist: Encrypted at rest and in transit

name: message-broker-ops
description: Operate Kafka/RabbitMQ/NATS: topics/queues, partitions, consumer groups, retention, DLQ. Use for broker setup/ops.

name: reverse-proxy-tls
description: Set up TLS termination, certificates (Let's Encrypt/ACME), HSTS and modern cipher configs. Use for HTTPS/cert setup.

name: cron-scheduling
description: Schedule reliable recurring jobs with cron/systemd timers/Task Scheduler: locking, logging, alerting on failure. Use for scheduled tasks.

name: artifact-registry-ops
description: Manage package/artifact/image registries: versioning, retention, promotion, signing. Use for registry and release-artifact ops.

name: microservices-patterns
description: Design microservices: boundaries, communication, resilience (circuit breaker, retry, timeout), saga. Use when splitting or integrating services.
checklist: Service boundaries follow domain, not layers

name: service-mesh
description: Use a service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) for mTLS, traffic shaping, and observability. Use when adopting/operating a mesh.
pitfalls: Adopting a mesh before you need it

name: chaos-engineering
description: Test resilience with controlled fault injection (latency, failures, resource limits). Use to validate reliability assumptions.
checklist: Blast radius bounded; run in a safe env first
pitfalls: Chaos in prod with no guardrails

name: capacity-planning
description: Plan capacity and autoscaling: load testing, headroom, cost/performance tradeoffs. Use when sizing infrastructure.
pitfalls: Sizing from guesses, not load tests
